༄༅/ /drang srong dri med la chu gtor 'bul ba tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs mchod pa'i sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// drang srong dri med la chu gtor 'bul ba tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs mchod pa'i sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/bla ma dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid drang srong dri ma med pa'i lha mchog ma hā ri ṣi'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir drang srong nyid kyi sgrub pa pos lhag chad kha skong bar bya ba dang*/ nam 'dod dus drang srong la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ tshar brgya'am gang gtong ba'i grangs kyi dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ 'bru sna sogs la ril bu star kha tsam byas la snod du bzhag /chu gtsang ma 'o ma bsres pa 'bag btsog ma song bar byas la bzhag /zangs sogs rin po che'i snod cis kyang shis la/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs kyis skyabs 'gro byas la/ bdag drang srong khros pa'i khro bo gzhung ltar sgoms la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du paṃ las padma a las zla ba'i steng du āḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ drang srong dri med sku mdog dkar po 'od 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas gser gyi spyi blugs dang*/ g.yon pas lung thang gi bgrang phreng thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis sems skyil gyis bdag cag la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar āḥdakar pos mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ ri bo kun 'dus kyi rtse/ nags tshal dra ba can gyi phug nas drang srong 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa'i// lha yi rgyal po drang srong mchog /drang srong 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor| sgo gsum gus pas bstod par bgyi/ zhes bstod/ rin po che'i snod du ril bu gcig dang chu de'i gang blugs la/ a kā ro gsum brjod/ gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum brjod/ kha kha khā hi khā hi du na ye swā hā/ drang srong chen po dri med 'od zer la drang srong 'bum phrag du ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams kyi zhal du i dam ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

zhes gsum mo/ drang srong 'khor dang bcas pa la// gtor ma phul ba'i mthu stobs kyis// tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs mthar phyin te// 'bras bu sku gsum mngon gyur shog /ces brjod chu dang ril bu gtsang sar bsham par bya'o// tshar du bya yang gong ltar byas la tshar rjes ma'i mjug tu mchod bstod gong ltar byas la yi ge brgya pa tshar gcig gis lhag chad kha bskang*/ badzra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang gi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur ces dang*| bkra shis brjod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs kyis dge ba sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo/ dmigs med kyis rgyas gdab bo// zhes drang srong dri med la gtor ma 'bul bar bya ba'i phyir/ shākya'i btsun pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas loka tri'i bsnyen mtshams zhag gcig tu bris pa mastu/// / ༈ /drang srong la brten nas shes rab sgrub thabs bzhugs so// drang srong chen po dri med 'od zer la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir drang srong gi dbang lung nod pa'i skye bo blo chung ngur gyur pa rnams/ zab cing rgya che ba'i gsung rab gzhung lugs sna tshogs pa'i tshig 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa la slob cing don khong du chud bar 'dod pas/ drang srong la brten nas shes rab bskyed par spro na/ 'tshe ba med pa'i gnas su yar tshes bzang po dag la/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod gtsang mar gtor ma 'dab ma bzhi pa la/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ shing 'bras sogs ci 'byor dang*/ mchod pa sna lnga sogs bshams/ drang srong gi zhal thang yod na'ang dgram/ med na tsaka li gtor mar btsug /rang nyid kyang zas gos ngan pa dang grib la 'dzems shing sgo gsum gyi mi dge ba spangs/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs rgyas bsdus gang rung byas rjes/ chos thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad dkar dang*/ a las zla ba'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo dri ma med pa dung ltar gsal ba'i āḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas|

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mchod/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi snying gi mun pa bsal/ slar 'dus pa las rang nyid drang srong dri med 'od zer sku mdog dkar la zhi zhing 'dzum pa mtshan dpe'i yon tan du mas brgyan pa/ g.yas shel gyi ral gri dang g.yon shel dkar gyi bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ ras dkar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ ri bo kun 'dus kyi rtse/ nags tshal dra ba'i klong sogs nas// rang 'dra'i ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung dkrigs pa lta bur bzhugs pa la/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ slar yang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes 'od kyi phung por gyur pa rang dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam la/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥdakar po'i mthar mdun nas g.yas skor du/ oṃ trang du tri na trang du dzā dzā pradzñā siddhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags 'khor 'gal me ltar drag tu 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa dang*/ 'jam dbyangs/ dbyangs can ma la sogs kyi shes rab thugs rje ma lus pa bsdus/ thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim pas don spyod pa'i spob pa dang ldan par mos la/ bzlas pas 'dod pa phul du phyin par 'gyur ro// thun mtshams su gsol ba gdab pa ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa yis// bdag blo'i snying gi mun pa rab bsal nas// ston pa'i gsung bzhin ma nor rtogs pa dang*// 'chad rtsod rtsom dang mchog thun dngos grub stsol// zhes dang thun mtshams su gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ a kā ro dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis drangs nas gsol bar gyur par bsam/ ngag tu yang*/

gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'di nyid drang srong chen po dri med 'od zer la lha'i drang srong 'bum phrag du mas bskor ba'i zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ du na ya swā hā/ i dam ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gsum gyi mthar/ drang srong dri med la sogs pa'i/ lha mi'i drang srong thugs brtse ba'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis zag med kyi bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la/ bdag sgrub pa po'i mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ don spyod pa'i shes rab/ zab pa/ brtan pa/ myur zhing gsal ba/ tshig 'dzin 'chad rtsod rtsom sogs gang la yang mi thogs shing*/ don gnyis 'grub pa'i dngos grub myur du stsol cig /ces sogs smon lam gang 'dod btab/ shes rab bskyed thabs 'di/ shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog ming gis rang lo bco lnga'i thog tu pho brang rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa 'dis 'gro la phan par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
